glosses: to crystallize (to make something form into crystals)
to crystallize (to give something a definite or precise form)
to crystallize (to assume a crystalline form)
to crystallize (to take a definite form)

examples.text: Anhydryt krystalizuje w układzie rombowym.
Większość miodów nektarowych krystalizuje po jednym do sześciu tygodni.

glosses: To make something form into crystals.

examples.text: I crystallized the copper sulfate by slowly cooling a saturated solution.
The copper sulphate crystallized from solution.

glosses: To give a definite or precise form to (something).

examples.text: After some thought, I crystallized my ideas for the paper.
My ideas crystallized overnight.
The situation did crystallize, if painfully, under the stars, and by morning each knew what he must confess.

glosses: To coat something with crystals, especially with sugar.

examples.text: We crystallized the fruit by coating in sugar.

glosses: Non-Oxford British English spelling of crystallize.

examples.text: Nevertheless, it occasioned considerable dissatisfaction, which soon crystalised into a rival concern, the Aberdeen, Peterhead & Fraserburgh Railway.

glosses: Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of crystallize.
